responsibility: This implementation module supplies the GNU Modula-2 runtime backend for Logitech-compatible keyboard handling. It reads raw characters from file descriptor 0 and uses the Selective wrappers around fd sets, timeval objects, and select to implement KeyPressed as a nonblocking test for pending stdin input.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the Keyboard pair: it reads from file descriptor 0 and uses Selective fd-set and timeout wrappers to implement KeyPressed, whereas Keyboard.def only declares those keyboard services.
